I read the original in full (39 FR 36317): EO 11813 of Oct. 7, 1974 defines cooperative education, permits noncompetitive conversion on four conditions, directs Commission regulations, revokes EO 11202 (a revocation spent on issue) and is effective immediately; identity is confirmed and it has no own-terms end. The held FR text of EO 12015 (42 FR 56947, Oct. 26, 1977) says in Sec. 4 that Executive Order No. 11813 of October 7, 1974 is hereby revoked; the APP text matches, EO 12015 has no deferred effective date, and the held 5 U.S.C. 3301 note agrees. Cruden found no other held text naming EO 11813 and no earlier end, so the whole order ended 1977-10-26 and status no holds.
